doc: docs/rust-ci.md (Conformance check) and docs/adr/0004-fleet-rust-compile-cache.md. Read by scripts/audit_rust_cache.py. Every exemption names its class, reason, owner and a review date; one past its review date stops applying and the repository is audited again.

pin_floor.note: A rust-sccache pin is conformant when it is this commit or a descendant of it: the commit rust-ci.yml pins. Move the floor forward when a fix every caller needs lands.

rustc_default_note: The commit that made `rustc` the rust-sccache default key-prefix. Set it to that merge commit once it lands: a pin at or after it may leave key-prefix unset. Until then (empty) every direct rust-sccache step must say `key-prefix: rustc` itself.

hands-off.meaning: A delivered customer repository or a protected original. Its files are never read.

own-cache-setup.meaning: Compiles Rust on its own sccache setup (not the rust-sccache action) in the same `rustc` namespace, until the BuildCache move in ADR 0004 phase 2. Its files are not read.

exemptions.reason: Delivered customer repository (bgca), protected original (hk-mahjong-tycoon) and the hosted stopgap (openclaw-sylphx): no work unless their owner asks.

scripts/ci/setup-rust.sh sets sccache up directly on the platform bucket with the `rustc` prefix and a post-merge verify run that warms it (ADR 0004 context). It moves to the shared action with the BuildCache phase.
